description: US Treasury debt composition from the Monthly Statement of the Public Debt. Omit BOTH args for the newest month's full class breakdown; pass security_type AND security_class together for that one class's monthly history (passing only one of them is IGNORED). Returns {summary, rows}. AMOUNTS ARE IN MILLIONS OF USD -- a 28,000,000 value means $28 trillion. The breakdown holds component AND Total rows, so summing a column double-counts. `limit` (series only) default 120 months, hard cap 360. An unreachable store is REFUSED (DATA_UNAVAILABLE). Sibling of get_yield_curve. Source: Treasury.gov MSPD (public domain); FREE. Caveats ride the response's tool_notes.

limit.description: Monthly points for a series (default 120, hard cap 360).

security_class.description: Class within the type; '_' for Total rows.

security_type.description: e.g. 'Total Public Debt Outstanding' (with security_class for a series).

name: ol_treasury_debt
